selection_rule: Positive size-128 local CE fidelity, local CE above random p95, local-minus-global CE advantage at least 0.10, greedily retaining distinct layers.

hypotheses.N0_native_replay_is_exact: Maximum native replay logit error is at most 0.02.
hypotheses.N1_specialized_banks_improve_finite_logi: Specialized banks beat global banks in finite logit-effect fidelity for at least three of four targets and by at least 0.05 on average.
hypotheses.N2_specialized_banks_improve_finite_ce: Specialized banks beat global banks in signed CE-effect fidelity for at least three of four targets and by at least 0.05 on average.
hypotheses.N3_specialized_banks_beat_random_control: Every specialized bank beats the 95th percentile of sixteen equal-size random banks in finite logit-effect fidelity.
hypotheses.N4_fixed_128_channel_banks_are_often_suf: At least two targets reach finite logit-effect fidelity at least 0.50 with 128 fixed native channels.
hypotheses.N5_local_linear_advantage_predicts_finit: Local CE-bank advantage correlates at least 0.50 with finite signed CE-effect advantage across the four targets.
